description: This file defines jQuery UI Effects 1.5, including effect functions, class effects, color animations, and easing functions, used for visual effects and animations in web interfaces.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current style properties of an element for later restoration.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores previously saved style properties to an element.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Determines the effect mode ('show', 'hide', or 'toggle') based on element visibility.

methods.name: getBaseline
methods.description: Calculates a baseline point for animation based on origin and original size.

methods.name: createWrapper
methods.description: Wraps an element in a container for effects, adjusting positioning.

methods.name: removeWrapper
methods.description: Removes the wrapper container around an element.

methods.name: setTransition
methods.description: Sets CSS transition properties for animation.

methods.name: animateClass
methods.description: Animates class addition, removal, or toggle effects.
